prompt: Convert the World War II notes file into RemNote flashcards. Read the file at evals/samples/world-war-2-notes.md, analyze all the historical facts, dates, events, causes, and consequences described. Generate a comprehensive set of flashcards covering the war's timeline, key battles, leaders, causes, and consequences. Use appropriate card types for factual information, dates, and relationships. Output the flashcards to evals/samples/world-war-2-notes-flashcards.md.

assertions.name: file_exists_and_non_empty
assertions.description: Output file exists and contains at least 25 flashcards

assertions.name: has_concept_cards
assertions.description: Contains at least 3 Concept cards (::) for key events like Pearl Harbor, Holocaust, D-Day

assertions.name: has_date_cloze_cards
assertions.description: Contains at least 5 Cloze cards ({{ }}) with dates (e.g., September 1 1939, 1945, June 6 1944)

assertions.name: has_leader_cards
assertions.description: Contains flashcards for major leaders: Hitler, Churchill, Roosevelt, Stalin, Mussolini, Hirohito

assertions.name: has_bidirectional_cards
assertions.description: Contains at least 1 Bidirectional card (<>) for leader-country or event-year pairings

assertions.name: has_variety_of_types
assertions.description: Uses at least 4 different card types (Concept, Cloze, Bidirectional, Forward Basic)

assertions.name: no_metadata
assertions.description: Contains no HTML comments, metadata, or annotations

assertions.name: covers_major_events
assertions.description: Includes flashcards covering: causes, European theater, Pacific theater, key battles, turning points, Holocaust, ending, consequences
